meta.title: DSS 15 REST API coverage matrix
meta.sdkSnapshot: src/resources (44 files) + src/cli working tree 2026-09-09; CLI catalogue = buildCommandRegistry()/commandActionSummary(): 55 resources / 474 actions total (47 API-facing resources / 466 API actions + 8 meta-commands: agent, auth, batch, cleanup, commands, fixtures, install-skill, version). Mappings machine-validated: every nonempty CLI mapping exists in the catalogue and every cited SDK method is a public method on its client resource class (private helpers are cited only via their public callers).
meta.countingCaveat: Rows are documented operation entries (method + documented URI, identity by doc anchor). The 372 official entries resolve to 371 distinct (method, URI) pairs: the official page documents GET /admin/connections/{connectionName} twice (a known doc duplication); both entries are retained. Query variants on one row are not double-counted. Where the SDK reaches the same capability via a different verb/path it is recorded as implemented with a drift note, never counted twice.
meta.parityPolicy: No coverage percentage is claimed; counts are raw row tallies validated against the programmatic CLI registry (buildCommandRegistry()) at snapshot time.

duplicateDocOperations.explanation: The official DSS 15 REST page documents this operation twice (the second entry is a doc bug); both documented operation entries are kept because each carries its own doc anchor. 372 documented operations resolve to 371 distinct (method, URI) pairs.

Projects.name: List projects
Projects.note: Docs publish the list endpoint as GET /projects/{tags} with an optional tags selector; the SDK GETs /projects/ and filters client-side. The same normalized shape also matches GET /projects/{projectKey}/ (project details), so both list and get land on this row.

Bundles, Design-side.name: Create a new bundle
Bundles, Design-side.note: Path-shape drift: official "Create a new bundle" is PUT /projects/{projectKey}/bundles/exported/ with bundleId in the body; the SDK PUTs /bundles/exported/{bundleId} (id in path) and also forwards releaseNotes/evaluateProjectStandardsChecks query params.

Bundles, Design-side.name: Delete an exported bundle

Connections.name: Get connection
Connections.note: Config read stays on the admin path per docs. TEST-ROUTE DRIFT (documented): the official REST page has no connection-test route (the GET /admin/connections/{connectionName} entries are ambiguous); the official Python client (dataikuapi/dss/connection.py, DSSConnection.test, master) uses GET /public/api/connections/{name}/test — connections-admin uses the Python-verified /test route for testing, and the admin path for config read.
